properties.natural_language: The upgrade_to_fulu function MUST only be invoked when the current slot is at an epoch boundary (slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0) AND the epoch equals FULU_FORK_EPOCH.

reachability.notes: A bug in fork epoch detection could cause premature or delayed fork activation, leading to a network split if some clients fork at wrong epoch.

properties.severity_justification: Incorrect fork epoch detection causes a network-wide consensus split affecting all clients.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing divergent fork activation timing.

properties.natural_language: After upgrade_to_fulu completes, the state fork object MUST have current_version == FULU_FORK_VERSION (0x06000000), previous_version == ELECTRA_FORK_VERSION, and epoch == FULU_FORK_EPOCH.

reachability.notes: Incorrect fork version in state would cause all post-fork signature verification to fail, splitting the network.

properties.severity_justification: Wrong fork version causes all post-fork block/attestation signatures to be computed against incorrect domain, crashing consensus for all nodes.

properties.natural_language: After upgrade_to_fulu completes, all Electra state fields (validators, balances, slashings, participation records, sync committees, execution payload header, pending operations) MUST be preserved identically in the Fulu state.

reachability.notes: Data loss during state migration would corrupt validator records, balances, or pending operations.

properties.severity_justification: Loss or corruption of any state field during fork migration affects all validators and the entire network state.

properties.natural_language: After initialize_proposer_lookahead completes, the proposer_lookahead field MUST contain exactly (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH entries, each being a valid validator index from the active validator set.

reachability.notes: Non-deterministic or incorrect lookahead computation causes proposer disagreements across nodes.

properties.severity_justification: Incorrect proposer lookahead causes nodes to disagree on valid block proposers, potentially splitting >33% of the network.

properties.natural_language: The proposer_lookahead computation MUST be deterministic: given identical beacon state at the fork epoch, all conforming implementations MUST produce identical proposer_lookahead arrays.

reachability.notes: Non-determinism in proposer computation would cause consensus failure.

properties.severity_justification: Non-deterministic proposer assignment causes network-wide consensus split.

properties.natural_language: If the current epoch is not FULU_FORK_EPOCH, the fork upgrade MUST NOT be triggered and the state MUST remain in Electra format.

reachability.notes: Premature fork activation would split the network.

properties.severity_justification: Premature or spurious fork activation causes network-wide split.

properties.natural_language: The fork upgrade MUST be applied during state replay when processing the slot at FULU_FORK_EPOCH boundary, regardless of whether the node is syncing or live.

reachability.notes: Nodes that skip the fork during sync would produce inconsistent post-fork state.

properties.severity_justification: Syncing nodes that miss the fork transition would fork off the main chain.

properties.natural_language: The irregular state change (upgrade_to_fulu) MUST be called after normal epoch processing at the fork epoch boundary, not before or instead of it.

reachability.notes: Wrong ordering of epoch processing vs fork upgrade produces different post-state, causing consensus split.

properties.severity_justification: Ordering error in fork processing causes divergent state roots across implementations.

properties.natural_language: An attacker MUST NOT be able to manipulate the randomness seed used by initialize_proposer_lookahead to bias proposer selection at the fork boundary.

reachability.notes: Attacker who controls RANDAO reveal at the epoch before fork could bias proposer selection for the initial Fulu epoch.

properties.severity_justification: Biased proposer selection at fork boundary gives disproportionate block production rights but existing RANDAO protections limit scope.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing RANDAO manipulation leading to biased proposer assignments.

properties.natural_language: After field migration, every Electra state field MUST be present in the Fulu state object with identical values, preserving validator continuity and historical integrity.

reachability.notes: Missing or corrupted field during migration causes state root mismatch.

properties.severity_justification: Any field corruption during state migration produces divergent state roots, splitting the entire network.

properties.natural_language: After fork metadata is set, state.fork.current_version MUST equal FULU_FORK_VERSION (0x06000000), state.fork.previous_version MUST equal ELECTRA_FORK_VERSION, and state.fork.epoch MUST equal FULU_FORK_EPOCH.

reachability.notes: Incorrect fork version breaks all post-fork signature domain computations.

properties.severity_justification: Wrong fork version causes all signature verifications to fail network-wide.

properties.natural_language: Post-fork, all blocks and attestations MUST use FULU_FORK_VERSION in their signature domain computation. Any message using a pre-Fulu fork version MUST be rejected.

reachability.notes: A malicious validator could send blocks/attestations with wrong fork version to cause processing errors or bypass validation.

properties.severity_justification: Accepting blocks with wrong fork version could cause >33% of the network to follow an invalid chain.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing acceptance of pre-Fulu signed messages post-fork.

properties.natural_language: After proposer_lookahead is initialized, the proposer for any slot MUST be read from the lookahead array, not computed on-the-fly. The lookahead array MUST be the sole source of proposer assignments.

reachability.notes: Using a different proposer selection method post-fork causes nodes to disagree on valid proposers.

properties.severity_justification: Inconsistent proposer selection causes nodes to reject valid blocks, potentially splitting >33% of the network.

properties.natural_language: The proposer_lookahead MUST be fully initialized before any post-fork block production or validation occurs. No block proposer selection may occur while STATE-LOOKAHEAD-UNINITIALIZED.

reachability.notes: Race condition where block validation occurs before lookahead is initialized could cause undefined behavior.

properties.severity_justification: Block validation without initialized lookahead could crash nodes or cause incorrect proposer verification.

properties.natural_language: Validator client queries for proposer duties via Beacon API MUST return data derived from the deterministic proposer_lookahead array, not from independent computation.

reachability.notes: Beacon API is explicitly out-of-scope. However, incorrect duty responses could cause missed proposals.

properties.severity_justification: Incorrect proposer duties affect individual validators, not the network consensus.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Beacon API is out-of-scope per bug bounty program.

properties.natural_language: The custody_group_count advertised by a validator MUST be monotonically non-decreasing: once advertised, the count MUST NOT be reduced, even if the validator's effective balance decreases. The highest ever computed value MUST persist across restarts.

reachability.notes: A bug causing custody count reduction after restart would degrade data availability.

properties.severity_justification: Custody count reduction across many validators could degrade data availability for >5% of the network.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Configuration-dependent; requires node restart with lost persistence.

properties.natural_language: The custody requirement computation MUST clamp the result between VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT (8) and NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS. The formula is: total_validator_balance / BALANCE_PER_ADDITIONAL_CUSTODY_GROUP (32 ETH), clamped to [8, NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS].

reachability.notes: Missing clamping could assign 0 custody groups (if balance is 0) or overflow the max.

properties.severity_justification: Incorrect custody computation across many validators degrades data availability sampling guarantees.

properties.natural_language: When custody count increases, the validator MUST immediately advertise the updated custody_group_count to the network before its next attestation duty.

reachability.notes: Delayed advertisement causes peers to under-sample this validator's custody groups.

properties.severity_justification: Delayed custody advertisement affects individual validator's contribution to data availability.

properties.natural_language: A validator MUST NOT advertise a custody_group_count that is lower than a previously advertised value, even after restart or balance decrease.

reachability.notes: A malicious validator could advertise a lower custody count to reduce their data availability obligations, degrading network guarantees.

properties.severity_justification: Systematic custody count deflation by many validators could degrade data availability below safety threshold.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing custody count deflation affecting sampling.

properties.natural_language: DataColumnSidecar construction from block MUST receive a valid signed beacon block with matching blob commitments and associated blob data. The block MUST contain valid KZG commitments.

reachability.notes: If EL provides invalid blob data via Engine API, constructed sidecars would be invalid.

properties.severity_justification: Invalid sidecars from a buggy EL propagated to the network could cause data availability failures for >33% of the network.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Conditional on EL providing invalid data via Engine API.

properties.natural_language: Cell KZG proofs received from the Execution Layer via GetPayloadResponse MUST be verified before constructing DataColumnSidecars for distribution.

reachability.notes: Engine API is semi-trusted. If CL skips KZG verification of EL-provided cell proofs, a buggy or compromised EL can cause invalid sidecar distribution.

properties.severity_justification: Unverified cell KZG proofs from EL propagated as sidecars could trigger consensus failures across >33% of the network.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Key boundary: CL must verify EL-provided cell proofs before distribution.

properties.natural_language: Sidecar reconstruction via get_data_column_sidecars_from_column_sidecar() MUST only be called with a valid, integrity-verified sidecar. Invalid or malformed input sidecars MUST be rejected.

reachability.notes: A malicious peer could send a crafted sidecar that passes initial checks but causes errors during reconstruction.

properties.severity_justification: Crafted sidecar causing reconstruction crash could bring down >33% of nodes receiving it via P2P.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing malicious sidecar causing reconstruction failure.

properties.natural_language: After sidecar construction, each DataColumnSidecar MUST contain valid Merkle inclusion proofs linking the column data to the signed block header.

reachability.notes: Invalid Merkle proofs in sidecars would be rejected by receiving peers, breaking data availability.

properties.severity_justification: Invalid Merkle proofs cause all receiving peers to reject sidecars, breaking data availability for the block.

properties.natural_language: Each DataColumnSidecar MUST be published to the correct pubsub subnet as determined by compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar(column_index). Publishing to the wrong subnet causes data to be unreachable by sampling nodes.

reachability.notes: Wrong subnet computation causes data to be unreachable, degrading availability.

properties.severity_justification: Wrong subnet mapping causes data column unavailability, affecting sampling for >5% of the network if the bug is in a popular client.

properties.natural_language: The BlobsBundle in Fulu MUST use cell-level KZG proofs exclusively. Blob-level KZG proofs from pre-Fulu formats MUST NOT be accepted or processed post-fork.

reachability.notes: If EL sends old blob-level proofs instead of cell proofs, CL must detect and reject them.

properties.severity_justification: Accepting wrong proof type could cause invalid sidecars to be distributed, affecting >5% of the network.

properties.natural_language: A DataColumnSidecar MUST only be stored if it belongs to a custody group that this validator is responsible for. Sidecars for non-custody groups SHOULD be rejected at the storage layer.

reachability.notes: A malicious peer could flood sidecars for non-custody groups to exhaust storage.

properties.severity_justification: Storage exhaustion via non-custody sidecars affects individual nodes, not network-wide.

properties.natural_language: Within the retention period (MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs), a validator MUST NOT prune any stored DataColumnSidecar. Pruning MUST only occur after the retention period has fully elapsed.

reachability.notes: Premature pruning degrades data availability for sampling nodes.

properties.severity_justification: Premature pruning across many validators could make data unavailable for sampling, affecting >5% of the network.

properties.natural_language: Peer requests for DataColumnSidecars MUST be validated: requested slot must be within the retention window, column index must be valid (within bounds), and the request must not exceed rate limits.

reachability.notes: A malicious peer can send crafted sidecar requests with invalid slot ranges or column indices to cause errors or resource exhaustion.

properties.severity_justification: Malformed requests could cause crashes or resource exhaustion on >5% of nodes if the bug is in a popular client implementation.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing malformed P2P request causing node crash or resource exhaustion.

properties.natural_language: Peer sidecar requests MUST include valid column indices within [0, NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS). Out-of-bounds column indices MUST be rejected without processing.

reachability.notes: Out-of-bounds column index could cause array index out of bounds panic or memory corruption.

properties.severity_justification: A single P2P packet with out-of-bounds column index could crash all nodes running a vulnerable client (>33% if major client).
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing single P2P request causing node crash.

properties.natural_language: The erasure coding scheme MUST ensure that reconstruction of all columns requires at least the data availability sampling threshold number of columns. Reconstruction from fewer columns than the threshold MUST NOT be possible.

reachability.notes: If erasure coding is weaker than expected, a block producer could withhold data while passing sampling checks.

properties.severity_justification: Broken data availability guarantee allows data withholding attacks affecting all validators relying on DAS.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing reconstruction from fewer columns than safety threshold.

properties.natural_language: All DataColumnSidecars received via P2P pubsub MUST be fully validated before processing: KZG proof verification, Merkle inclusion proof verification, column index bounds check, slot validity, and proposer signature verification.

reachability.notes: Unauthenticated P2P peers can send arbitrary crafted sidecars. Missing validation could lead to state corruption or crashes.

properties.severity_justification: A single crafted P2P sidecar bypassing validation could corrupt state or crash all nodes running the vulnerable client.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Highest priority: P2P input validation is the primary attack surface.

properties.natural_language: Pre-merge history expiry MUST NOT be triggered until EIP-7642 (eth/69) is fully implemented AND all pre-merge deposit logs have been processed by the consensus layer via EIP-6110.

reachability.notes: Premature history expiry before deposit log processing could cause CL to miss validator deposits.

properties.severity_justification: Premature history expiry could cause CL to miss deposit logs, affecting validator activation for >33% of the network.

properties.natural_language: After history expiry, the sync algorithm MUST only sync from the merge block forward. Sync MUST NOT attempt to retrieve or validate pre-merge blocks from P2P peers.

reachability.notes: If sync still attempts pre-merge block retrieval after expiry, it could stall or fail.

properties.severity_justification: Sync failure after history expiry could prevent new nodes from joining, affecting >5% of the network over time.

properties.natural_language: After history expiry, the client MUST correctly handle the absence of pre-merge PoW-specific fields (totalDifficulty, etc.) when processing eth/69 protocol messages. Missing pre-merge fields in valid post-merge blocks MUST NOT cause validation failures.

reachability.notes: Malicious peers could send blocks with manipulated field presence/absence to exploit eth/69 parsing inconsistencies.

properties.severity_justification: eth/69 parsing bug exploitable via P2P could crash >33% of nodes running a vulnerable client.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing crafted eth/69 message causing node crash.

properties.natural_language: Data retrieved from alternate sources (e2store, Portal Network, EIP-7801) MUST be validated against canonical block hashes before use. Unverified external data MUST NOT be served to clients or used for state computation.

reachability.notes: Malicious Portal Network nodes or e2store mirrors could serve manipulated historical data.

properties.severity_justification: Serving manipulated historical data could mislead applications but does not directly affect consensus of >5% of the network.

properties.natural_language: JSON-RPC requests for pre-merge data MUST return an appropriate error response when data is unavailable locally and cannot be retrieved from alternate sources.

reachability.notes: JSON-RPC API is explicitly out-of-scope per bug bounty program.

properties.severity_justification: JSON-RPC is out-of-scope; this is a code quality recommendation.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: JSON-RPC API is out-of-scope per bug bounty program.

properties.natural_language: Block data received via eth/69 protocol from P2P peers MUST be validated against canonical block hashes. With pre-merge fields dropped, sync logic MUST correctly handle the absence of PoW-specific fields without accepting invalid blocks or rejecting valid ones.

reachability.notes: Malicious peers can send blocks with missing or extra fields via eth/69 to exploit parsing inconsistencies.

properties.severity_justification: Block validation bypass via eth/69 could cause nodes to accept invalid blocks, splitting >33% of the network.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing crafted eth/69 block causing validation bypass.

properties.natural_language: History expiry MUST NOT be activated on mainnet before Pectra fork activation. The activation sequence (devnet -> Sepolia -> Pectra -> mainnet) MUST be followed strictly.

reachability.notes: Premature mainnet activation before Pectra could break CL deposit processing.

properties.severity_justification: Premature mainnet history expiry could break CL deposit processing, affecting validator activation for >33% of the network.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Configuration-dependent; requires operator error in activation sequencing.

properties.natural_language: CL clients MUST have fully implemented EIP-6110 (in-protocol deposits) before history expiry is activated, eliminating CL dependency on EL deposit contract logs.

reachability.notes: If EIP-6110 is not fully implemented, CL would fail to process new validator deposits after history expiry.

properties.severity_justification: Missing EIP-6110 implementation combined with history expiry would prevent all new validator activations, affecting the entire network.

properties.natural_language: All blocks received via P2P gossip post-fork MUST have their proposer index verified against the deterministic proposer_lookahead array. Blocks from non-assigned proposers MUST be rejected.

reachability.notes: Malicious validator could propose blocks for slots they are not assigned to, attempting to inject unauthorized blocks.

properties.severity_justification: Accepting blocks from unauthorized proposers could cause fork choice manipulation affecting >33% of the network.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing acceptance of block from non-assigned proposer.

properties.natural_language: eth/69 protocol implementations MUST correctly handle the absence of totalDifficulty and other pre-merge fields. Peers sending blocks with unexpected field presence/absence MUST be disconnected.

reachability.notes: Malicious peers sending blocks with pre-merge fields still present (or missing required post-merge fields) via eth/69 could exploit parsing bugs.

properties.severity_justification: A single crafted eth/69 message could crash nodes running a vulnerable client, potentially affecting >33% of the network.
properties.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing crafted eth/69 message causing node crash.
